remarks: Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this Glenbrook 1-bedroom apartment with heat and hot water included! Enjoy easy one-level living featuring an open-concept living room and an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops. The spacious bedroom, large bathroom and hardwood floors throughout make this one worth the wait! Storage won't be an issue with ample closet space and a large private storage cage located next to the on-site laundry. Outside, you'll have one reserved parking space ensuring hassle-free parking. Enjoy a walkable lifestyle and stress-free commuting - walk to the Glenbrook Train Station (just 6 minutes away) as well as nearby restaurants, shops and entertainment; also convenient to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. Don't miss out on this opportunity! Schedule your viewing today!
